response.justification: Despite extensive software engineering experience, the candidate lacks direct C++ development experience in industrial automation, high-performance systems, or secure embedded environments as required; their work centers on JavaScript/TypeScript, DLang, and web technologies with minimal evidence of STL, multi-threading, MQTT, IEC 62443, or industrial protocol expertise.
strengths: Strong full-stack and cross-platform development experience across diverse systems
Proven track record in open-source contributions and technical mentorship
Demonstrated ability to build event-driven and distributed systems
concerns: No demonstrable C++ or STL experience in professional industrial or embedded contexts
Lacks exposure to industrial cybersecurity standards (IEC 62443), MQTT, or industrial protocols
Primary tech stack is web-focused (JS/TS/DLang), not aligned with C++-centric on-prem/cloud automation systems
